newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sunright sets up S$4 mln Hong Kong plant.
newsitem.headline: Sunright sets up S$4 mln Hong Kong plant.

text.p: Sunright Ltd said on Wednesday it has set up a new Singapore $4 million facility in Hong Kong, which provides burn-in of semiconductor chips.
The 14,000 square feet production area is part of Sunright's strategic regional expansion, the company said in a statement.
Sunright's executive chairman and chief executive officer, Sam Lim said the company sees the Hong Kong plant as a first step into China market.
"After Hong Kong, our next plan of expansion is in Korea, known to be one of the world's largest producer of memory chips," Lim said.
Sunright share ended eight cents higher at S$2.60 on Wednesday.
